mapper.sql: post_id, post_code, post_name, post_status, remark, creator, open_status
mapper.select:
select from cbs.t_post
open_status = true
and (post_name like concat('%', #{kw}, '%') or post_code like concat('%', #{kw}, '%'))
order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into cbs.t_post (post_id, post_code, post_name, post_status, remark, creator, open_status) values (#{p.post_id}, #{p.post_code}, #{p.post_name}, #{p.post_status}, #{p.remark}, #{p.creator}, #{p.open_status})
mapper.update: update cbs.t_post set open_status = false where post_id = #{id}
